decisions.reason: The dietary supplement range has shown no continued promotion or traction after 2019, so its option value is likely low and resources should be reallocated.
The skin and hair supplement lacks evidence of market success after its launch, suggesting its option value has not been realized and it should be dropped.
The joint health supplement has no visible market presence or positive signals after 2019, making further investment unattractive under real options reasoning.
Although immune products saw temporary demand, the mushroom supplement's absence from the website and lack of demonstrated value mean the option is unlikely to pay off.
The valsartan product's 2018 recall and quality problem is a strong negative signal that resolves uncertainty about its value, so it should be abandoned.
The OTC migraine triptan is newer and still holds option value because the OTC migraine market remains uncertain and may develop further, so the firm keeps it.
